title: Wiktionary page
description: One page of a Wiktionary as one JSONL line (wikt2jsonl). Sections form the tree of the page's headings 1:1 (template lines like pl {{synonimy}} one level below the last heading); translations stand next to senses, not linked to them yet.

source.description: Where the page is in the dump: [start of its bz2 block (multistream index offset), number of the page in that block]; null for samples

language.description: Language as written in the page (name, code or template)

code.description: Canonical code (wiktlangs.sqlite), null when not known

native.description: The section is in the wiki's own language

text.description: Raw wikitext before the first section

unknown_headings.description: Headings without an English section name yet

section.description: English name: Noun, Synonyms, Translations; null when not known

heading.description: Heading, template line or italic line as written

level.description: Heading level; template lines one below the last heading

template.description: The section is a template line, not a heading

text.description: Raw wikitext of the section; of a part of speech what is no sense (headword line, inflection templates); none in translation sections

see.description: Translations on other pages (en {{trans-see|gloss|color}}, tr {{çeviri yönlendirme}}, nl zie [[weer#Vertalingen]])

page.description: wiktlink: the page has a section of the language

subpage.description: wiktlink: Translations of the translation subpage (en water/translations) merged here

source.description: wiktlink: where a merged subpage is in the dump, as the page's source

source_title.description: wiktlink: the title of the merged subpage (water/translations)

section.description: A section; empty sections and empty or default fields are left out; template lines have no level; the kind (part of speech, relation) follows from the English name (wiktsections.sqlite)

examples.description: Raw wikitext of the examples and quotations below the definition (#:, #*)

media.description: Names of Wikimedia Commons files (sounds, pictures) in the text, without the namespace

lang.description: Canonical language code, null when not known

lang_written.description: Language as written when it differs from lang

sense.description: Sense number given by the wiki (pl 1.1, fr/de table number, es a1), empty when none

gloss.description: Gloss of the sense of the translation table (en {{trans-top|domestic species}}, sv {{ö-topp|vätska}}): to be matched to a definition

gender.description: Gender and number marks as written: m, f, n, c, m-p, ż

page.description: wiktlink: this wiki has a page of the term with a section of the language

en.description: wiktlink: en.wiktionary has a page of the term with a section of the language

home.description: wiktlink: the Wiktionary of the language has a page of the term with a section of the language

page_title.description: wiktlink: the title of the page found when it is not the term (without accents, optional parts)
